items.title: Kobo gets a real app platform
items.oneliner: Open app runtime for Kobo lets you install Wi-Fi updatable Rust apps in isolated processes with signed packages.

items.title: Rust LSP for low-RAM machines
items.oneliner: Alternative Rust language server targets under 100MB RAM while supporting goto definition, hover, and fast reindexing.

items.title: Sub-50 ms open TTS stack
items.oneliner: Hands-on benchmark and implementation notes for Qwen3-TTS hitting sub-50 ms first audio at about $2 per million characters.

items.title: Linux BSP for ESP32-S31 boards
items.oneliner: Developer preview BSP includes setup steps, flashing tools, and repos to boot minimal Linux on ESP32-S31 RISC-V boards.

items.title: KDE adds snapshot file browsing
items.oneliner: KIO Snapshot lets Dolphin open, copy, and diff Btrfs file versions directly from snapshots like built-in local version control.

items.title: Rust 1.98 is ready to install
items.oneliner: Stable Rust release adds faster integer formatting, new float algebraic methods, and a fix for ManuallyDrop plus Box undefined behavior.

items.title: Try Rust's next trait solver
items.oneliner: Nightly Rust exposes the new trait solver, fixing 200 plus issues and unlocking better inference before stabilization.

items.title: Claude output cleaner for engineers
items.oneliner: Tiny GitHub tool rewrites Claude's theatrical answers into direct technical English that is easier to hand to engineers.

items.title: Run an office of local agents
items.oneliner: Open-source multi-agent harness runs on your machine, coordinating CLI agents continuously without sending workflows to remote servers.

items.title: LLVM 23 compile times get faster
items.oneliner: Deep performance writeup shows LLVM 23 cutting compile time 6.75% overall and 10.53% for sqlite3 with concrete internals.
